## Two independent occurrences measured tonight — this card's defect is costing whole rounds, not just leaving a red

`domain:spec` execution seat, `session_01MkQhmuuJAVDjmeWNixwDDH`, 2026-09-11T08:36Z. Adding measurements, ⛔ not a new claim: this card already states the shape (the gate prescribes a discharge the repo's merge settings make unreachable — squash lands `COMMIT_MESSAGES`, the gate wants `PR_BODY`).

### The two instances, hours apart, by different rounds

| card | PR | commit | red |
|---|---|---|---|
| #17464 | #17649 | `7bd20c60e` carries `Part of #17464` in its MESSAGE | `Part-of PR must not also close its card` → failure |
| #17475 | #17652 | `6f2d6d9ac` carries `Part of #17475` in its MESSAGE | same check → failure |

Neither round was careless in the ordinary sense — both reported the red themselves, read the gate's text correctly, and ⛔ declined to amend, rebase, force-push or push a cosmetic commit. Both stopped at exactly the right place. The defect is that **by the time the rule is enforced, the cheap fix is already gone**: the gate reads the PR's COMMIT LIST, so once the branch is pushed, nothing an author may legally do removes the message.

### What that costs, measured

Each occurrence cost a **full extra round** — a new branch, a re-applied diff, a new PR, and the old one closed as superseded. That is the seat's call, and I made it twice for the same reason both times: the landing pre-check is *"every check green, newest run per NAME"*, and this card's own finding is why the red cannot simply be landed through — **the discharge is unreachable**, so the trailer would sit in permanent history and the red would never clear.

⇒ ⭐ The gate is correct about the contract and correct that it "does not decide whether the pull request merges". The problem is purely one of **timing**: it is a post-push detector for a pre-push mistake.

### The cheap check that prevents it, offered as evidence rather than a prescription

The #17464 redo ran this before pushing and came back clean first time:

```
git log -1 --format=%B  |  grep -oiE … | wc -l      (⛔ not grep -c)
  DARK  #17464 / Part of / Part-of / Refs / Fixes / Closes / Resolves / #[0-9]+   → 0 each
  LIT   Co-Authored-By → 1 · Claude-Session → 1 · KnowledgeSourceSchema → 1
```

and then fed the **old** commit to the same instrument, which exited 1 — so the green was a reading rather than a check that could not fail. ⚠️ I have since put that grep into every dispatch this seat writes, but that is a per-seat patch on prose, ⛔ not a mechanism: the next seat that does not know about it pays the same cost.

⛔ I am not prescribing the fix — whether that belongs in a pre-push hook, in `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` as a mandatory step, or in the merge setting this card already names is the owning lane's call, and this seat does not edit `scripts/pm/**` or the governed surface. ⛔ No `domain:*` and no priority from me.

Related: #17649 → superseded by #17653 (clean commit message, gate green, verified with a two-legged local run) · #17652 → same redo in progress · #15913 (a claim corrected during review still ships in history — the squash message no review round reads) · #17280 (the same trailer pair, the model-free half, also unenforced).

## 门禁自身的一个缺口:`Part-of:` 冒号写法不被 RULE 2 捕获 —— 而每份派发令都在禁它

`domain:spec` 执行席代 #17184 轮次转贴,2026-09-11T15:5xZ。⛔ 不是新主张,是那一轮**双腿实测**出来的。

### 读数

`scripts/check-partof-closing-keyword.mjs` 的 `partOfRe` 是 `/\bPart of\s+#(\d+)\b/gi` —— **要求一个空格**。实测同一个 commit:

```
commit message 带 'Part of #17184'   -> exit 1(被抓)
commit message 带 'Part-of: #17184'  -> exit 0(漏过)
```

### ⚠️ 为什么值得记,而不是「反正冒号形式没用」

那一轮自己给出了不立卡的理由,我认同它的事实但**不认同据此收口**:冒号写法对板面同样是惰性的(板面工具读的也是那一种拼写),所以它**既不会关卡也不会动卡**,危害比空格写法小。

⭐ **但真正的问题在别处:这个座位每一份 `os-dev` 派发令都把 `Part-of` 列进禁止形式**(我今天写了七八份,条条如此)。⇒ 一个照令行事、推前 grep `Part-of` 的 dev,**grep 得到 0 并以为过关,而门禁根本不会替他兜底**。禁令与门禁不同步,恰恰在「我要求 dev 自己验」的那一步上。

⇒ 这不是「漏抓一种无害拼写」,是**指令面与执行面不一致**:我让 dev 相信有一道网,那道网在这一格没有线。

### ⛔ 我不提修法

改 `partOfRe` 是收紧一道门禁的匹配面,属于门禁强度,是维护者地板,也不是 `domain:spec` 的落点。可能的方向(⛔ 仅供接手者判断,不是建议):让门禁也认冒号形式;或反过来,把派发令里的 `Part-of` 从禁止清单里去掉,让指令与门禁一致。**两者选哪个是裁决,不是执行。**

### 相关

本卡已记的另一半仍然成立:即便抓到了,在**已推送**的分支上也**无法解除**(squash 取 `COMMIT_MESSAGES`),所以今天两轮都是重开 `-v2` 分支重来。⇒ 这一格的价值全在**推之前**,而推之前唯一的网就是 dev 自己那条 grep —— 更说明禁令与门禁必须对齐。

⭐ 顺带一个今天第三次出现的实测:**子串误报**。这一轮 commit 初稿因 `a closed ten-member enum` 里的 `closed` 被自己的 grep 判出 `Closed 1 / Close 1`,在**提交之前**改成 `an exhaustive ten-member enum`。前两次分别是 `findClosestMatches` 里的 `Closes` 和 `fixture` 里的 `fix`。⇒ 推前 grep **必须分别数裸词干**,否则这三次都会漏。

## Ruling recorded — **A** on #17606 (with #15913) — the squash message comes from the PR body; the part-of gate moves pre-push (director seat, summon #22, `session_01QsCVSivtpwT6ZXs5Rtvqxe` (GitHub `os-tesla`)), 2026-09-12T00:17Z

Provenance: maintainer, director chat, 2026-09-12, decision batch #116, verbatim 「其他同意」 on the presented recommendations (`1A·2A·3A·5A`; item 4 = #17396 withheld for a design discussion). Freshness gate: comments newer than the presentation re-read before recording.

**Ruling A.** The repository setting `squash_merge_commit_message` becomes `PR_BODY` on both governed repos this session can read (objectstack and objectui both read `COMMIT_MESSAGES` at 2026-09-12T00:15Z), so the landed message is the text a review round read and corrected, by mechanism rather than discipline. In the same ruling the gate's prescription stops being unreachable: the card-trailer check moves to **pre-push** and `check:partof-closing-keyword` is re-scoped to the PR body once the setting flips — filed as **#17727** (`domain:skills`, `pm:queue`, p2), which also closes the `Part-of:` colon gap the spec seat measured at 5637102799. ⛔ Not B (「contradicts」 is not mechanically checkable), ⛔ not C/D (discipline and a per-PR human tax).

**Why the setting is the maintainer's act:** a repository setting has no file, no PR and no seat that may write it. This card and #15913 enter `pm:awaiting-maintainer` with the line below; the director seat verifies the exit by reading the two repo objects and clears the label with the evidence.

Maintainer-action: set the repository's default squash-merge commit message to the pull request body (GitHub → Settings → General → Pull Requests → “Default commit message” → *Pull request title and description*) on **both** `objectstack-ai/objectstack` and `objectstack-ai/objectui` — done when `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack` and `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui` both report `squash_merge_commit_message: PR_BODY` (read 2026-09-12T00:15Z: both `COMMIT_MESSAGES`).

**Open reading, stated once:** whether PR bodies in this repo make good landed messages is unmeasured (the four-facet block's own gap); the first week of `PR_BODY` squashes is the measurement — if bodies land as unreadable history, the skills seat files a body-shape rule, ⛔ not a reversal of the setting.

State: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:awaiting-maintainer` (one replace write, read back). #15913 moves in the same stroke; #17280 (model-identifier trailers) stays its own card and is discharged by the same setting.

## Done — maintainer ruled option 1 on 2026-09-12: 「改成 PR_BODY」

Applied and independently read back:

```
before   squash_merge_commit_title = COMMIT_OR_PR_TITLE   message = COMMIT_MESSAGES
after    squash_merge_commit_title = PR_TITLE             message = PR_BODY
```

⚠️ **The title setting had to move too, and that was not optional.** The first attempt — changing only the message — was refused by the API:

> Sorry, invalid setting combination. The following are valid combinations for the squash commit title and message: PR_TITLE and PR_BODY, PR_TITLE and BLANK, PR_TITLE and COMMIT_MESSAGES, COMMIT_OR_PR_TITLE and COMMIT_MESSAGES.

`PR_BODY` exists only in combination with `PR_TITLE`. So reaching the ruled setting required the paired change; there was no path to `PR_BODY` that left the title alone.

**What actually changes as a result of that second half:** `COMMIT_OR_PR_TITLE` used the single commit's subject when a PR had exactly one commit, and the PR title otherwise. `PR_TITLE` always uses the PR title. So multi-commit PRs are unaffected, and single-commit PRs now land under their PR title rather than their commit subject. Recording it because it was not in the ruling's words and someone will notice the difference.

## What this now means in practice

The landed squash message is the PR body — a text an author wrote and a reviewer read. `check:partof-closing-keyword`'s discharge is reachable for the first time.

⚠️ It also makes the PR body **load-bearing in a new way**: it is no longer just review context, it is the permanent commit message on `main`. PR #17454's body is 462 lines, which lands verbatim. That is not wrong — it is an authored text, which is the whole point — but it is worth knowing that body length is now commit-history length.

Closing: the decision is taken and applied. ⛔ Option 2 (retire or re-scope the gate) is moot now that the discharge works.
